hero.h1: ChatGPT Transcribe Audio – Turn Audio Into Text in ChatGPT With TranscriptX
hero.subtitle: Connect TranscriptX to ChatGPT, then attach any recording or paste a podcast link. TranscriptX transcribes the audio and hands the full text to ChatGPT, so you can summarize, translate, quote or turn it into notes without leaving the chat. Free to start, in over 100 languages.

quickAnswer.question: Can ChatGPT transcribe audio?
quickAnswer.answer: Yes, with TranscriptX. Connect TranscriptX to ChatGPT once, attach an audio file or paste a link, and ask ChatGPT to transcribe it. TranscriptX turns the speech into text and returns the full transcript to the chat, where ChatGPT can summarize, translate or answer questions about it. Setup takes about a minute — see the Transcription MCP guide.

sections.h2: How ChatGPT Transcribes Audio With TranscriptX
content: ChatGPT is great at working with text, but it is not built to turn long recordings or media links into a complete transcript on its own. TranscriptX fills that gap.

Once TranscriptX is connected, the work is split in two. TranscriptX listens to the audio and turns it into an accurate transcript. ChatGPT then receives that transcript and does what it does best — summarizing, translating, explaining and rewriting.
You stay in one chat the whole time. Attach the file, ask for a transcript, and keep going with your next question.

sections.h2: Why Use TranscriptX to Transcribe Audio in ChatGPT

items.content: Without TranscriptX you transcribe in one tool and paste the text into ChatGPT. With it, the transcript lands directly in the conversation.

items.h3: Full transcripts, even for long recordings
items.content: Meetings, lectures and podcast episodes are transcribed in full, not cut short. Long transcripts are read in parts so ChatGPT can work with the whole recording.
Transcribe recordings in the language that was spoken, then ask ChatGPT to translate them into any other.
Attach MP3, WAV, M4A and other audio or video files, or paste podcast, YouTube, Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive links.
The result card has Copy and Export buttons for TXT, SRT and VTT, plus a link to open the full transcript in TranscriptX.
TranscriptX only receives the file or link you ask it to transcribe — never your other messages. Uploaded files are deleted within 12 hours.

sections.h2: What You Can Do With the Transcript in ChatGPT
intro: Transcribing is only the first step. Once TranscriptX has handed the text to ChatGPT, try prompts like these:

items.content: “Turn this into meeting minutes with decisions and action items.”
“List the three strongest quotes from this interview.”
“Make study notes and 10 quiz questions from this lecture.”
Turn spoken ideas and reminders into clean, organized notes.
Get the full transcript, then ask ChatGPT for minutes and follow-ups.
Keep exact wording for quotes, and let ChatGPT find the key moments.
Transcribe a whole class and turn it into study material.
Paste an episode link to transcribe, summarize or translate it.
